articles.title: Meth is a key driver in Fiji's fast-growing HIV epidemic: 1 in 60 adults are affected
articles.description: In mid-September, Fiji's government declared a national emergency because of a startling rise in HIV infections. The country's crystal meth epidemic is a strong contributing factor.
articles.content:
Best known as a tropical paradise and honeymoon destination,the island nation of Fiji now has the unfortunate distinction of facing two intertwined epidemics: HIV and addiction to crystal meth.
